# nupdf

> nupdf is an open-source PDF engine for AI agents, written in Rust. One binary reads, searches, renders, edits and redacts PDFs, and answers every command with a versioned JSON report. It runs as a command-line tool, as an MCP server, or as a Rust library.

Source: https://github.com/raspao-studio/nupdf (AGPL-3.0-or-later, derived from MuPDF by Artifex Software, Inc.)
Docs: https://nupdf.dev/docs/

## Install

    cargo install --locked nupdf-cli

The binary is `nupdf`. It needs Rust 1.92 or newer. `ocr` also needs Tesseract on PATH.

As an MCP server (one tool per command):

    claude mcp add nupdf -- nupdf mcp

As a Claude Code skill:

    mkdir -p ~/.claude/skills/nupdf && nupdf guide --skill > ~/.claude/skills/nupdf/SKILL.md

## How to use it

Run `nupdf guide` once: it describes every command on one page. Start a file with `info`. Inputs are never modified: commands that write need `-o <path>` and support `--dry-run`.

    nupdf info report.pdf                         # triage: pages, text layer, scans, forms, signatures, what to run next
    nupdf extract report.pdf --format markdown    # the text, as Markdown (also json, jsonl, text, layout)
    nupdf extract report.pdf --pages 1-3 --max-chars 8000
    nupdf search contract.pdf "terminat" --options ignore-case
    nupdf render report.pdf -o pages --pages 1-3 --dpi 72
    nupdf redact statement.pdf -o clean.pdf --preset email --preset phone
    nupdf verify clean.pdf --preset email --preset phone

Other commands: tables, fonts, images, annots, forms, signatures, outline, links, labels, attachments, merge, split, pages, meta, clean, flatten, sanitize, encrypt, decrypt, ocr, diff, batch, schema. `nupdf --help` lists them and `nupdf <command> --help` gives the options.

## Reading the result

- stdout is one JSON object with `schema` (for example `nupdf.extract/v1`), `doc_id` and `diagnostics`. Add `--pretty` to indent it.
- Errors are JSON on stderr: `{"schema":"nupdf.error/v1","error":{"code","message","hint"?}}`.
- Exit codes: 0 success, 1 internal error, 2 usage error, 3 input error (unreadable, not a PDF, wrong password), 4 verification failed, 5 limit exceeded.
- Large outputs stop at a whole block with `"truncated": true` and a `next_cursor`; pass it to `--cursor` to continue.
- Pages are 1-based. Selections: `1-3,7`, `N` for the last page, `5-N`, `N-1` for reverse order.
- Content ids: `p3` (page), `p3.b2` (block), `p3.b2.l4` (line), `p3.b2.l4.s1` (span), `p3.b2.l4.s1:5-12` (characters). Search returns them and `redact --id` accepts them.
- Coordinates are points, origin at the top left, y down.
- Encrypted files: pass `--password`.

## When another tool is the better choice

- A short document that is mostly charts or scanned pages: let a vision model read the page images.
- Reading order and tables that need a layout model: nupdf's are MuPDF's heuristics.

## More on this site

- [The MCP server](https://nupdf.dev/mcp/): adding nupdf to an agent, and what each tool returns
- [Redaction](https://nupdf.dev/redact/): what `redact` removes and what `verify` checks
- [Compared with other tools](https://nupdf.dev/compare/): an agent eval and speed against PyMuPDF, pypdf, PDFium, Poppler and PDF Oxide, and when to pick each
